text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Christmas Day—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...
This is on a much bigger scale than I imagined.
choice_data_list: I didn't expect it to be a party on a ship...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Orfevre-san.
Even her fans are on a whole different scale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lucky Lilac and I had been invited to a Christmas party
organized by Orfevre's fans...
âLala-san. Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for taking the time out of your busy schedule to come today.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san. Thank you very much
for inviting me as well.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "...This gathering was organized by the fans who wanted to celebrate Christmas with Orfevre."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"And at the same time, I want anyone and everyone
connected to Or to equally enjoy themselves—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That is what the fans, as well as the "King", desire.
Please make sure to create some wonderful memories today.
choice_data_list: Thank you. I'll take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Also, please make sure
to show your face to Orfe, too.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"She's in the VIP room on the top floor.
I've already let them know you're coming."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
I'll come by shortly.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, that's right.
I forgot to mention—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"It suits both of you very well.
You look even more wonderful standing side by side."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san. Thank you so very much
for inviting me today.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...In the previous Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It was a battle more than worthy of piquing my interest.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: This banquet is your reward. At ease.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (She's praising meeeeeeeeeee!! Orfe-san really—no doubt about it! Praised my running!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(No way, no way, no way!
I'm so happy...!!
I can't believe they were watching me...!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Uuuugh, I feel like I'm gonna cry...! 
But I gotta pull myself together! This is my moment to shine!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: âI am honored that you watched.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I shall continue to devote myself, blooming ever more magnificently so as to shine brightly in Orfe-san's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The piercing gleam in Orfevre's eyes seemed to be asking a question.
"What about you?" it seemed to say.
choice_data_list: ...I'll continue to support her so she can bloom.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is why she would no longer rely on Orfevre like before.
She would stand by Lucky Lilac's side and support her herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I replied with a gaze that conveyed more than words ever could. Once again, with gratitude toward Orfevre—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Do your best, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: You look happy.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Well, of course. After all, the Japan Cup was a culmination of everything I achieved as the "Queen."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That caught Orfe-san's eye.
It makes me want to stand even taller.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...And besides—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san, you told Trainer
to "keep at it," didn't ya?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: That made me... so happy, too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"It feels like they've finally accepted
us as a duo—"
choice_data_list: I need to stay focused too.
I need to brace myself too.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
I'm counting on you, partner.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's keep this celebratory mood going
and enjoy today to the fullest, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here,
would you mind escorting me?
choice_data_list: Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I spent a delightful Christmas with a cheerful Lucky Lilac...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, I enjoyed the Christmas party with a cheerful Lucky Lilac...—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*...
Today was a really fun day, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. If ya don't mind,
can I drop by the trainer's room after this?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to sip some tea
and bask in the afterglow of today just a little longer.
choice_data_list: Got it, let's take it easy for a bit

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While getting ready to have tea
with Lucky Lilac in the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas.
choice_data_list: What!? When did you bring that along!?
What!? When did you bring that!?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, to tell the truth, I hid it in the Trainer's room beforehand.
I wanted to surprise you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Please open it if you'd like.
I hope you like it, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Lucky Lilac's urging, I open the present.
Inside was—
choice_data_list: Oh...! It's a necktie...!
Whoa...! It's a scarf...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Set against understated tones, this piece with its subtle floral embroidery
evoked a sense of high quality through its meticulous craftsmanship...
choice_data_list: Thanks! Mind if I try it on for a second?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since I was already dressed formally for the party today, I was able to match right away. It feels like a much better fit for me than I'd imagined...!
choice_data_list: Thank you, this is amazing!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, wonderful.
It looks great on you.
choice_data_list: ...Well then, here's something from me to you.
...Well then, here's something from me to you.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: Merry Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hand Lucky Lilac her present.
Coincidentally, I had also hidden one in
the Trainer's office to surprise her.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like the two of us
were thinking the exact same thing.
choice_data_list: I was surprised when you served it first!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Can I go ahead and open this?
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, what a lovely handkerchief...!
The color is just my style, and it feels so soft...!"
choice_data_list: This was custom-made, actually.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Is that true...!?
Thank you so much, doing all this for my sake... wait—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: .....................The tiara embroidery...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
choice_data_list: I wanted to praise your hard work as the "Queen".
I wanted to praise your hard work as the "Queen".

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: This is the tiara that makes me happier than any other.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I'll cherish it.
...Always.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...No good—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Looks like I'm already about
to use this handkerchief...—)
